lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance white circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns across the central and posterior visible flank; the most prominent nodes are centered in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, dark circular anomaly is visible on the upper mid-flank; the trailing edge of the pectoral fin exhibits a non-uniform, notched profile.
